title: [S-M42-01] Unify the JARVIS content-package orchestrator with the full-script 30/40/50-minute pipeline
prompt:
Source inspection (2026-10-31, main @ 7d56fef) found the JARVIS content-package path is still the pre-#250/-#257 design:

- `src/jarvis/deterministicNarrationPlan.js:48` rejects `targetMinutes > 30` — it cannot plan 40/50-minute episodes, while the production pipeline (`src/pipeline/narrationScript.js`, merged in #250/#257) plans all three targets.
- `src/jarvis/contentPackageOrchestrator.js` requires externally supplied `timedNarrationSegments` for its subtitle stage and truthfully reports `skipped_pending_input` / `NARRATION_SEGMENTS_REQUIRED` — it neither consumes the new full narration script nor triggers measured narration generation through the executor.

The full-script production fix and rate calibration therefore do NOT reach the JARVIS orchestrator yet; the two paths share no narration runtime.

## Scope (offline only — no publishing, no owner gates)

- [ ] Raise `deterministicNarrationPlan` bounds honestly to the 30/40/50-minute planning targets (keep fail-closed validation; no silent widening of other fields)
- [ ] Derive timed narration segments deterministically from the full `buildNarrationScript` output instead of requiring owner-supplied segments; retain `NARRATION_SEGMENTS_REQUIRED` for genuinely missing input (never invent timings)
- [ ] Route the orchestrator's narration/text stage through the same measured, calibrated audio contracts (executor + completeness gate) that the production runner uses — one narration runtime, not two
- [ ] Keep the orchestrator's honesty contract: stages that cannot run report skipped pending input; no placeholder media, no fake durations (Rules 1–3)
- [ ] Cross-module regression tests: 30/40/50-minute packages produce consistent plans, subtitles bound to the real script text, and unchanged honest states for missing input
- [ ] Update docs (R7) for the jarvis module and any plan reference

## Non-goals

Creative/editorial story quality (deterministic planning text remains labeled planning text), live publishing, OAuth, credentials (#118), Android console work (#258).

## Verification

- npm test / lint / verify / plan:check green + CI on the PR head
